hints.title: Counting Character Frequencies
hints.text: Accumulate occurrences of each distinct character present in the string.

hints.title: Comparing Frequency Values
hints.text: Check whether every unique character produced an identical frequency count.

hints.title: Cardinality of Frequency Set
hints.text: Inserting all frequency values into a deduplicated set should produce a cardinality of exactly 1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def areOccurrencesEqual(self, s: str) -> bool:
        counts = Counter(s)
        return len(set(counts.values())) == 1
```
